metadata.selection_criteria: All DVWA vulnerability modules at Low security level, that fall within the scanner's detection categories. Horizontal IDOR testing is limited by DVWA's absence of a built-in registration page. Additional user accounts are created via direct MySQL `INSERT` commands inside the Docker container, if horizontal auth testing is required. This ground truth reflects  that the modules the scanner can test reliably at `Low` security level.

entries.name: Login Endpoint Has No Rate Limiting
entries.expected_behaviour: Repeated POST requests with wrong credentials to /login.php must be throttled or locked out after a configurable threshold. DVWA at Low security level applies no rate limiting to the main login endpoint.

entries.name: CSRF Token Absent on Password Change Form
entries.expected_behaviour: The password change form at `/vulnerabilities/csrf/` must include an unpredictable CSRF token, that the server validates on every submission. DVWA at `Low` security level omits this token entirely, allowing for cross-site request forgery.

entries.name: Vertical Privilege Escalation via Security Configuration
entries.expected_behaviour: A non-admin authenticated user, or unauthenticated session, submitting a `POST` request to `/security.php` to change the DVWA security level must receive 403, or be redirected. Only the admin role may modify the security configuration. `/security.php` is used by the admin role in `post_auth_steps` in `dvwa.yaml`, making it a confirmed admin-only endpoint for `vertical_auth.py` replay testing.

entries.name: Predictable Weak Session IDs Issued
entries.expected_behaviour: The `dvwaSession` cookie issued by `/vulnerabilities/weak_id/` must be cryptographically random, and unpredictable across repeated requests.  DVWA at `Low` security level generates sequential integer session IDs, which are trivially enumerable.

entries.name: PHP Configuration Page Exposed to Authenticated Users
entries.expected_behaviour: The PHP configuration page at `/phpinfo.php` must not be accessible to low-privilege authenticated users. DVWA requires authentication to reach this page but applies no role check, meaning any authenticated user regardless of security level receives the full PHP environment dump, leaking server configuration, installed extensions, and environment variables.

entries.name: DVWA / Accessible Without Auth (By Design at Low Security)
entries.expected_behaviour: DVWA at Low security genuinely serves / without authentication. This is by design and not a scanner false positive in the traditional sense.
